text:
sam: Quick q — our service-account tokens don't currently surface org/project in telemetry, which makes quota attribution and billing joins annoying. Any objections to adding a structured header so gateways can short-circuit lookups? :thinking:

katie: I'm +1 for a structured header, but client adoption is the hard part. Proposal: optional header + server-side fallback to token lookup for old tokens.

eli: +1 to optional + fallback. Security: we should protect against spoofing — either sign the header (HMAC) or only accept it from internal gateways. I lean HMAC so external clients can still opt-in safely.

morgan: HMAC sounds good but note this implies a KMS call on validation unless we cache keys. Could add `x-redwood-actor` and `x-redwood-actor-sig`. We should measure p50 p99 impact.

javier: From quota side: flow should be: if header present and sig valid -> use header actor; else -> resolve actor from token; if token has no mapping -> mark as `unmapped` and route to fallback quota. Also emit a telemetry event when fallback happens: `actor_resolution.fallback`.

sam: Agreed. UX-wise, Console -> API keys should show `effective actor` and an ``Overrides header active`` badge if the header changes attribution. Rollout plan: canary to infra teams, then opt-in customers, then global rollout.

infra-bot: deploy-checklist: add metrics: `auth.header.present` (counter), `auth.header.sig_ok`, `auth.header.sig_bad`, `auth.fallback.used`, `auth.token.map_missing`. Add alert if `auth.header.sig_bad / auth.header.present > 0.001` (0.1%).

katie: Migration help: create `POST /auth/actor/validate` so clients can generate header, sign it and test it against our service without changing traffic. Docs + SDK helpers (python/js) needed.

eli: Also: redact header in longterm logs and enforce row-level access in BigQuery (PII). Add perf SLO: median latency increase <= 5ms for gateway validation path.

morgan: Example header to standardize (for docs):
```
x-redwood-actor: eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJub25lIn0.eyJ0eXBlIjoic2VydmljZV9hY2NvdW50Iiwib3JnIjoib3JnXzEyMyIsInByb2plY3QiOiJwcm9qXzQ1NiIsInNhIjoic2FfNzg5IiwiaWF0IjoxNjc4MDAwMDB9
x-redwood-actor-sig: abcd1234abcd1234  # HMAC-SHA256 over header using KMS key
```
# decodes to {"type":"service_account","org":"org_123","project":"proj_456","sa":"sa_789","iat":1678000000}

javier: Telemetry/dashboards: new panel `Auth: actor resolution` showing header adoption %, fallback rate, sig_bad spikes. Add A/B line for quota errors correlated with header adoption.

katie: UX acceptance: show warning if Console-API-key list has > 5% of keys with `unmapped` actor. Also add a quick migration CTA to generate a signed header for the key owner.

eli: Security note: signed header must expire (short TTL) and include `iat`/`exp`. Reject if `exp - iat > 5m` unless gateway-to-gateway internal token.

morgan: Action items (quick):
1) design header schema + canonical base64 payload (sam)
2) gateway validation + cache + perf (eli)
3) Console UX + migration CTA (katie)
4) telemetry metrics + dashboards (javier)
5) rollout plan doc + canary owners (morgan)
I'll file tickets and assign.

sam: SG, thanks everyone — I'll draft the design doc with examples and the canary checklist. :shipit:
